scope: 1 mm x 10 mm bump at 100 mm/s, B+S=2 kg, 5-50 N and 0-90 degrees, true force within 0.5 N throughout.
selectionScope: Both rigid, actual B/S cell, direct S-A tool position: 4 clean force/orientation corners plus 4 corners x 4 force/position-noise seeds. 10 kHz, calibrated 100 us force/position delay and filter/current response, 3.5 A; corrected direct Coulomb term. Selected worst case also 25 and 12.5 us plant steps.
measurementScope: Actual B/S load cell with 1.4 kg downstream, exact static gravity tare: Fc minus 1.4 times surface acceleration. Observer uses the matching measurement row; no surface or actual robot truth enters it. Issued robot commands drive a causal nominal predictor.
